spec_match.rationale: The builder now offers the six valid corner-shape keywords. Selecting square produces square in the generated rule and superellipse(infinity) in all four computed longhands; the functional example is shown in the sibling gallery.

interactive.rationale: MCP exercised all four selects, all four radius sliders and all three presets at both viewport sizes; generated rules, preview properties and computed read-back update.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The per-corner controls and shorthand collapse remain intact. The existing Ticket stub preset's naming problem is retained as a separate open question.

edge_cases.rationale: The invalid straight option is gone and square read-back no longer overflows mobile. The Ticket stub preset still sets four identical scoops rather than demonstrating mixed corners.

references.rationale: ChromeStatus and CSS Borders 4 references remain unchanged; the current value grammar was checked directly.

conformance.rationale: The existing immutable suite still checks shorthand parsing and longhand effects; it remains 1 pass / 7 fail in this MCP configuration. No assertion was changed to hide those results.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chrome DevTools MCP captured ten native states per viewport, including all-square and mixed values, all four sliders at 80px, and the presets; final console snapshots are clean. See reports/8vh-astra-20260924/.

telemetry_health.rationale: Existing corners-rendered client instrumentation was preserved and requests captured; backend storage was not audited in this fix.

design_system.rationale: Existing tokens and controls are retained. A scoped overflow-wrap:anywhere rule lets the longer superellipse(infinity) read-back fit the narrow table without clipping.

accessibility.rationale: All controls retain labels and heights of at least 44px. Keyboard range changes work, and generated output, the scoped-header table and polite live summary remain available as text.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Final ten-state runs at 360x740 DPR3 mobile/touch and 1280x800 DPR1 have no document overflow. An initial 373px mobile overflow with square selected was reproduced and corrected before this result.

openQuestions.title: Make the Ticket stub preset actually per-corner
openQuestions.detail: The existing preset still sets all four corners to scoop 26px and generates corner: scoop 26px, despite its comment promising per-corner control. This behavior was preserved by the vocabulary fix; a separate change should make the preset demonstrate mixed corners without disturbing the other controls.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive table long computed CSS values overflow-wrap anywhere prevent horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use progressive corner-shape enhancement and scoped wrapping for long tokens (sections 8 and 7).
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Retained the existing longhand fallback. Replaced the invalid keyword with square and wrapped table cells after its superellipse(infinity) serialization exposed mobile overflow.

summary: 8vh corrects the sibling builder's stale shape enum and makes its longer square serialization readable at 360px. Native MCP verifies every visible control and the new value on desktop/mobile. The Ticket stub preset issue and separate shorthand assertion failures remain honestly recorded. Independent review is required before publication.
